authenticity_review: Structural integrity is excellent; all guitars possess correct anatomical features (f-holes, bridges, pickups, 6 tuning pegs) and the topology mask shows clean separation without fusion. However, two distinct artifacts lower the authenticity score: 1) Headstock logos are illegible gibberish (e.g., 'ysim'), a clear text generation failure. 2) The spot patterns on the outer guitars appear slightly flat and lack the subsurface scattering seen in the realistic wood grain of the center guitar, suggesting texture mapping issues rather than physical paint. These are minor but noticeable deviations from photorealism.
key_defects: Headstock logos are illegible gibberish/text artifacts.
Center guitar lacks the requested 'spotted' attribute (only 4/5 are spotted).
Spot textures on outer guitars appear slightly flat/painted compared to realistic wood grain.
